en: Then wrought up with wrath, Dhananjaya dispatched, by means of his arrows, to the regions of Death, five hundred heroic Gandhara warriors with their weapons held over their heads.

sa: प्राग्ज्योतिषस्तु सहितो मद्रसौवीरकेकयैः। उरस्यभून्नरश्रेष्ठ महत्या सेनया वृतः॥
en: The ruler of the Pragjyotishas, united with the Madras, the Souviras and the Kaikeyas, and supported by a large division, was, O foremost of men, placed in its breast.

sa: इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः संनिवर्त्य सः। क्षुत्पिपासातपसहः कृशो धमनिसंततः॥
en: Withholding his senses from the objects pleasurable to them and suffering (patiently) the pangs of hunger and thirst, he tortured his body till his swollen veins appeared to view.

sa: तस्याभिपतस्तूर्णं भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। क्रुद्धश्चिच्छेद बाणेन धनुः शत्रुनिबर्हणः॥
en: Then the highly-powerful of Bharadvaja, that grinder of foes, excited with wrath severed, with a broad-head shaft, the bow of Dhrishtadyumna as the latter rushed against him with impetuosity.

sa: समस्तपापराशिघ्नं शृणु कीर्तयतो मम। धन्यमाख्यानमायुष्यं शोकनं पुष्टिवर्धनम्॥
en: Listen to me, O sire, as I go on repeating that ancient story. This story is excellent and enhances the period of life and kills sorrow and bestows health.

sa: कथितो नारदेनासि पूर्वर्षिरमितद्युते। वासुदेवसहायस्त्वं महत् कर्म करिष्यसि॥
en: You have been spoken of by Narada as an ancient sage, O you of dazzling effulgence. Having the son of Vasudeva for your helpmate, you shall achieve great feats,

sa: बाणशङ्खप्रणादाश्च भेरीणां च महास्वनाः। स्थघोषश्च संजज्ञे सेनयोरुभयोरपि॥
en: The whizzing of arrows, the blare of conchs, the loud sound of the drums, and the clatter of cars of the warriors of both the hosts were indeed awful.

sa: सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः। रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः॥
en: Those who know the day of Brahma, as being of one thousand ages, and a night of his, as being of one thousand ages (Yuga) know Day and Night.

sa: दौःशासनिरथोत्थाय कुरूणां कीर्तिवर्धनः॥ उत्तिष्ठमानं सौभद्रं गदया मूर्ध्यताडयत्।
en: Then that enhancer of the glory of the Kurus namely Dushasana's son rising first, smote Subhadra's son on the crown of his head as the latter was rising up.

sa: गदया वीरघातिन्या यथोत्साहं महामनाः। करोत्यसुकरं कर्म रथाश्वनरदन्तिषु॥
en: With his great mace that kills the heroes, this illustrious one (Bhishma), with the best of his powers, achieves the most difficult feats on foot-soldiers, horses, car and elephants.

sa: अभिपेतुर्भृशं क्रुद्धाश्छादयन्तश्च पाण्डवम्। तेषामापततां शब्दः शुश्रुवे फाल्गुनं प्रति॥ उद्वृत्तानां यथा शब्दः समुद्राणां युगक्षये। मतानयत गृह्णीत विद्ध्यध्वमवकर्तत॥ इत्यासीत् तुमुलः शब्दः फाल्गुनस्य रथं प्रति।
en: Indeed excited to the highest pitch of fury they fell upon that son of Pandu shrouding him (with those arrows). Great was the din that as they rushed against Phalguna's chariot. The challenges with loud voice of those warriors who attacked on Arjuna was heard like the roaring seas who violate the limits in devastation (Pralaya kala) and move forward to merge the entire universe with them. The dreadful words started making echo as-"Kill them", "Bring here", "trap soon", "pierce in pieces", "divide in small fractions" near the chariot of Arjuna.

sa: शून्या च पृथिवी सर्वा बालवृद्धावशेषिता। निरश्वपुरुषेवासीद् रथकुञ्जरवर्जिता॥
en: The whole earth appeared to be empty, having been destitute of men and horses, and of chariots and elephants. Only the children and the old remained (in their houses).

sa: तेजांसि रिपुसैन्यानां मृद्नन् पुरुषसत्तमः। अग्रऽग्रणीर्योत्स्यति नो युद्धोपायविचक्षणः॥
en: That foremost of men who knows all the appliances of battle, becoming our leader, will stand in front of our army, and crush the prowess of the enemy's troops.

sa: तं पद्मनिकराकारं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। व्याकोशपद्माभमुखो नीलो विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Then Nila, possessed of a countenance beautiful like full-blown lotus, began to pierce with his arrows him whose body resembled a cluster of lotuses and whose eyes resembled lotus-petals.

sa: गजस्थाश्च महामात्रा निर्मित्रहृदया रणे। रथिभिः पातिता भल्लैर्विकीर्णाङ्कुशतोमराः॥
en: In that battle elephant-drivers riding on their respective beasts and their beasts torn with broad-headed shafts by car-warriors of might, fell scattering their lances and hooks on all sides.

sa: युध्यमानं रणे शूरं विप्रचित्तिमिवामराः। न चैनं वारयामासुक्त्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Then like the immortals loO king, in the days of yore, at Viprachitti, the Partha's with depressed hearts began to look at your heroic father who was fighting fiercely;

sa: सुनसं सुललाटान्तं स्वक्षिभ्रदशनच्छदम्॥ अपश्यतस्तद्वदनं का शान्तिर्हदयस्य मे।
en: Graced with a beautiful nose and fore-head and eyes and eyebrows and teeth and lips. Oh, without seeing that countenance of his, I shall enjoy no peace of mind.

sa: सत्यप्रतिज्ञे त्वानीते पुन तेन निर्जिते। पुनर्यास्यन्त्यख्याय पाण्डवास्तमनुव्रताः॥
en: ever to.. his If Yudhishthira, truthful promises, be brought here alive, he being once more defeated at dice, the Pandavas obedient to him, will again repair to the woods.

sa: अन्योन्यमपि चाजघ्नुरात्मानमपि चापरे। पार्थभूतममन्यन्त जगत कालेन मोहिताः॥
en: They then began to strike one another and some of them again struck their ownselves. Confounded by Time, they then beheld the world to be full of battle only.

sa: आहूयोपह्वरे राजन्नुलूकमिदमब्रवीत्। उलूक गच्छ कैतव्य पाण्डवान् सहसोमकान्॥
en: And summoning in private Uluka, said these words o king: "O Uluka, O son of one who is skillful at dice, go to the Pandavas united with the Somakas.

sa: नैषां पश्यामि हन्तारं प्राणिनां संयुगे क्वचित्। विक्रमेणोपसम्पन्नास्तपोबलसमन्विताः॥
en: I do not see the slayer of these created beings in battle, (save one of their own class). They were possessed of prowess and endued with might and energy.

sa: एवं तां दर्शयन् कृष्णो युद्धभूमि किरीटिने॥ गच्छन्नेवाशृणोच्छब्दं दुर्योधनबले महत्। शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषं भेरीपणवनिःस्वनम्॥ स्थाश्वगजनादांश्च शस्त्रशब्दांश्च दारुणान्।
en: While Krishna was thus showing that field of battle to the diadem-decked Arjuna and going to their camp, he heard a loud roar in the army of Duryodhana. (In the army of Duryodhana were heard) the blare of conches and the best of drums and cymbals and the rattle of elephants and the dreadful class of innumerable weapons.

sa: ललाटेऽताड्यच्चैनं नाराचेन स्मयन्निव। ऊर्ध्वरश्मिरिवादित्यो विबभौ तेन पाण्डवः॥
en: Him then the preceptor checked like the continent checking the surging waves of the ocean; and then the latter smilingly pierced the former on the forehead with a Naracha.

sa: तत्रासीदूर्जितं मृष्टं काञ्चनं महदासनम्। शासनाद् धृतराष्ट्रस्य तत्रोपाविशदच्युतः॥
en: There in that place was a large wheat made of gold, of beautiful workmanship and ornamented with jewels, on which Achyuta took his seat at the request of Dhritarashtra.

sa: नारायणादृषिगणास्तथा मुख्याः सुरासुराः। राजर्षयः पुराणाश्च परमं दुःखभेषजम्॥
en: From Narayana, the Rishis the foremost of the deities, the Asuras, and the royal sages of old, acquired the knowledge of that highest panacea for the cure of sorrow.

sa: रसातलान्ते सलिलं जलान्ते पन्नगाधिपाः। तदन्ते पुनराकाशमाकाशान्ते पुनर्जलम्॥
en: Underneath, beyond the neither regions is water. Beyond water is the region of the great serpents. Beyond that is sky once more, and beyond the sky is water again.

sa: सुवर्णविकृतान् प्रासशक्तीः कनकभूषिताः। जाम्बूनदमयैः पट्टर्बद्धाश्च विपुला गदाः॥
en: (Behold) the spears adorned with gold and the Sakti-arrows also decorated with gold, as well as the huge maces bound with the threads of gold and chords of hemp.

sa: अन्तरात्मकमाकाशं तन्मयं श्रोत्रमिन्द्रियम्। तस्य शब्दं गुणं विद्यान्मूर्तिशास्त्रविधानवित्॥
en: Space is unoccupied interstice. The organs of hearing consist of space. One knowing the science of elements endued with form should know that ether has sound for its attribute.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कस्मात् समाने बहुलाप्रदाने सद्धिः प्रशस्तं कपिलाप्रदानाम्। विशेषमिच्छामि महाप्रभावं श्रोतुं समर्थोऽस्मि भवान् प्रवक्तुम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Why, O grandfather, do the righteous highly speak of the gift of a Kapila cow when all good kine that are given away should be considered as equal? O you of great power, I wish to hear what the superiority is of a Kapila cow. You are indeed, competent to discourse to me on this subject.

sa: सर्वगात्रप्रतायिन्यस्तस्या ह्यनुगताः शिराः। नेत्रयोः प्रतिपद्यन्ते वहन्त्यस्तैजसं गुणम्॥
en: Numberless other channels issuing from that principal one extend into every part of the body and bearing the element of heat cause the sense of vision (and the rest).

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच मत्प्रसादान्मनुष्येषु देवगन्धर्वयोनिषु। अप्रमेयबलात्मा त्वं नारायण भविष्यसि॥
en: The auspicious Lord said O Narayana, through my grace, among human beings, among the celestials and the Gandharavas, you shall be one whose soul and strength will be immeasurable.

sa: स एव विभवोऽस्माकमश्वानामपि गालव। अहमेप्येकमेवास्यां जनयिष्यामि पार्थिवम्॥
en: But in the matter of horses, my wealth is exactly like his (Haryashva) O Galava; and I too shall beget only one ruler of the earth on this girl.

sa: अव्यापारः परार्थेषु नित्योद्योगः स्वकर्मसु। रक्षणं समुपात्तानामेतद् वैभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Not to try to get the wealth of others, to perseveres in one's own affairs and to protect what has been earned, these are the indications of true greatness.

sa: पाद्यादीनि प्रतिग्राह्य पूजया परयार्चयन्॥ कालोपपन्नेन तदा स्वाद्वन्नेनाभ्यतर्पयन्।
en: Presenting him with water for washing his feet, and adoring him respectfully with the were offer of usual articles, they pleased him with excellent viands agreeable to the season.

sa: कृतां विन्दुसरोरत्नैर्मयेन स्फाटिकच्छदाम्। अपश्यं नलिनी पूर्णामुदकस्येव भारत॥
en: Having brought jewels from Bindu lake, Maya built a lake-like ground made of crystal. O descendant of Bharata, seeing the place full of lotuses, I mistook it for waster.

sa: अमावास्यां महातेजास्तत्रोन्मजन् महाद्युतिः। लोकान् प्रभासयामास शीतंशुत्वमवाप च॥
en: Bathing there on the day of the new moon, that god of great energy and great effulgence women regained his cool rays and began again to lleum the universe.

sa: अलातं तिन्दुकस्येव मुहूर्तमपि विज्वल। मा तुषाग्निरिवान—िमायस्व जिजीविषुः॥
en: Blaze up even for a moment like a piece of Tindula wood and do not like the fire of husk smoke away fireless out of your desire of life.

sa: हिमवत्सागरानूपाः सर्वे रत्नाकरास्तथा। अन्त्याः सर्वे पर्युदस्ता युधिष्ठिरनिवेशने॥
en: The Himalayas, the ocean, the regions on the sea-shore and the numberless other regions that yield gems and jewels have all acknowledged their inferiority to the palace of Yudhishthira.

sa: प्रकीर्णवस्त्राभरणा रुदत्यः शोककर्शिताः। स्वास्तीर्णशयनेपिता मागध्यः शेरते भुवि॥
en: Having all their ornaments displaced, crying, and stricken with sorrow, alas, those ladies of Magadha, worthy of sleeping on costly beds, are now lying down on the naked earth.

sa: राजर्षिवंशगोप्तारममरप्रतिमं नृपम्। यियासुं कश्यपं चैव न्यवर्तयत पापकृत्॥
en: Wicked in his deeds, he even made Kashyapa run away when he was coming for the relief of your god-like father, the protector of the race of royal sages.

sa: हैडिम्बो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु भगदत्तं समाद्रवत्। रथेनादित्यवर्णेन सध्वजेन महाबलः॥
en: Then the on of Hidimba, the foremost of the Rakshasas endued with great strength, riding on his chariot of solar has and furnished with a standard, rushed against Bhagadatta.

sa: ते हेमविकचा भूमौ युताः पर्वतधातुभिः। व्यराजञ्छाखिनस्तत्र सूर्यांशुप्रतिरञ्जिताः॥
en: And these trees, bright as gold, falling down upon the ground and dyed with the mountain metals, looked as if they were bathed in the rays of the sun.

sa: स त्वं विरुध्य तैवीरैरन्येभ्यस्त्राणमिच्छसि। अशिष्टेभ्योऽसमर्थेभ्यो मूढेभ्यो भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Yourself, being opposed to those heroes, desire to be served by those who are strangers to you, and who are dishonest, incompetent and fools, O best among the Bharatas.

sa: तथा ददर्श पाञ्चाली कमलोत्पलमालिनीम्। वपुषा स्वर्गमाक्रम्य तिष्ठन्तीमर्कवर्चसम्॥
en: He also saw the princess of Panchala, decked in garlands of lotuses, Having acquired the celestial region, she was sitting there, gifted with a form effulgent like the Sun.

sa: मनसश्चेन्द्रियाणां च यथैकाम्यमवाप्यते। येनोपायेन पुरुषैस्तत् त्वं व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: What are the means and what sort of singleness of purpose may inen acquire regarding both, viz., the mind and the senses? You should explain all this to me!

sa: सीताकपीन्द्रक्षणदाचराणां राजीवहेमज्वलनोपमानि। सुग्रीवरामप्रणयप्रसङ्गे वामानि नेत्राणि समं स्फुरन्ति॥
en: The left eyes of Sītā, the lord of apes, and night rangers-respectively like the lotus, gold, and flaming fire, throbbed when the friendship between Rāma and Sugrīva was contracted.

sa: उपपन्नं महाप्राज्ञे कृतास्त्रे सूतनन्दने। त्वयि विक्रमसम्पन्नमिदं वचनमीदृशम्॥
en: "O son of Suta, you are gifted with great wisdom and you are highly accomplished in arms. Such words breathing the spirit of heroism are surely worthy of you.

sa: त्वय्येतत् पुरुषव्याघ्र युक्तं राघववंशजे। गुरुवृत्तिर्दमश्चैव साधूनां चानुयायिता॥
en: foremost of men, even this is worthy of you. Serving superiors, restraint of the senses, and following the pious, are ever found in one sprung in the Rāghava line.

sa: बालेन्द्रगोपान्तरचित्रितेन विभाति भूमिर्नवशाद्वलेन। गात्रानुपृक्तेन शुक्रप्रभेण नारीव लाक्षोक्षितकम्बलेन॥
en: And the earth, covered with green grass and variegated with newly born insects, is appearing like a damsel clothed with a white blanket spotted here and there with lac.

sa: कामवीर्यः कामगमो देवराजभयप्रदः। इन्द्रोऽन्यः सर्वदेवानां भवेदिति यतव्रताः॥
en: “There will be another Indra of all the celestials, capable of going everywhere at will mustering any measure of strength at will and imparting fear to the present Indra.

sa: राज्यावृतं कृष्णविशालशुक्लम्। प्रास्पन्दतैकं नयनं सुकेश्या मीनाहतं पद्ममिवाभिताम्रम्॥
en: And the large left eye of that dame having graceful hairs, having dark pupils, white ends and thick eye-lashes, began to dance like a lotus shaken by a fish.

sa: अथैनमब्रवीद् वाक्यं लोकस्याधिपतिर्भवः। आश्वासनकरं वाक्यं वाक्यविद्वाक्य सम्मतम्॥
en: Once more, Mahadeva, that thorough adept in speech, addressed Daksha and said to him these words fraught with great consolation:-Be you the foremost of all creatures in the world.

sa: सर्प उवाच यदात्मद्रव्यमायुष्मन् देहसंश्रयणान्वितम्। करणाधिष्ठितं भोगानुपभुङ्क्ते यथाविधि॥
en: The Snake replied O long-lived being, the thing termed Atman taking refuge in a physical frame and manifesting itself through the organs of sense, enjoys properly the perceptible objects.

sa: मेघाः समुद्भूतसमुद्र नादा महाजलौघैर्गगनावलम्बाः। महीं च कृत्स्नामपवाहयन्ति॥
en: The clouds ranging in the welkin and discharging heavy showers, are roaring like to ocean; and the rivers, ponds and pools are deluging the earth with their watery contents.

sa: स राजा राजशार्दूल सत्यधर्मपरायणः। अन्तर्भूमिगतश्चैव सततं धर्मवत्सलः॥
en: King Vasu, O foremost of kings, was always devoted to the true religion. Although sunk deep into the bowels of the Earth, his devotion to virtue did not decrease.

sa: तमन्वयुस्तत्र तत्र दुःखशोकसमन्विताः। द्वारकावासिनः सर्वे पौरजानपदा हिताः॥
en: It was followed by all the citizens of Dwraka and the people of the provinces all of whom greatly stricken with grief, had been disposed towards the deceased hero.

sa: भुजनक्रा धनुःस्रोता हस्तिशैला हयोपला। मेदोमजाकर्दमिनी छत्रहंसा गदोडुपा॥
en: The arms were its alligators, bows its current, elephants its large rocks and its smaller ones. Fat and marrow constituted its mire, umbrellas its swans and maces its rafts.

sa: तस्यानुरूपो बलवान् रक्ताक्षो दुन्दुभिस्वनः। कनीयाँलक्ष्मणो भ्राता राकाशशिनिभाननः॥
en: Like to him in strength, of red eyes, and gifted with a voice like the sound of a kettledrum, his younger brother, Laksmana has a countenance resembling the full-moon.

sa: सर्वलक्षणहीनोऽपि समुदाचारवान् नरः। श्रद्वधानोऽनसूयुश्च शतं वर्षाणि जीवति॥
en: Even those men live for a hundred years who, though destitute of all accomplishments, follow propriety and righteousness of conduct and become endued with faith and freed from malice.

sa: आरण्यके मूलफलैस्तर्पयेत्तु द्विजोत्तमान्। अरणीपर्व चासाद्य जलकुम्भान् प्रदापयेत्॥
en: When the Aranyaka Parva is being recited, great Brahmanas should be fied with fruts and roots. When the Arani Parva is reached, waterpots full of water should be distributed.

sa: तस्या देव्या यथारूपमङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसौष्ठवम्। रामस्य च यथारूपं तस्येयमसितेक्षणा॥
en: Verily it appear from the grace of her person, from her well developed limbs and from Rāma's beauty that this worshipful damsel having darkblue eyes must be his spouse.

sa: ततो हताराक्षसपुङ्गवांस्तान् देवान्तकादित्रिशिरोऽतिकायान्। स्ते रावणाय त्वरिताः शशंसुः॥
en: Those Raksas that remained after the others had been slain, swiftly informed Răvaņa that all those foremost of Rākşasas Devantaka and the rest, Trisiras, Atikāya and others-had been slain.

sa: तमहं बलसम्पन्नं राक्षसं रणकोविदम्॥ परिघेणातिधोरेण सूदयामि सहानुगम्।
en: With my fierce mace I destroyed that mighty Rākşasa, versed in the art of war, along with his retinue and surrounded by a band of terrible and grim-visaged demons.

sa: तयोः समभवद्युद्धमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्। गगनस्थानि भूतानि लक्ष्मणं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: The encounter that took place between them was wonderful and capable of making people's down stand on end. And beings stationed in the sky surrounded Lakşmaņa on all sides.

sa: शङ्खराजरवश्चापि शार्ङ्गचापरवस्तथा। राक्षसानां रवांश्चापि ग्रसते वैष्णवो रवः॥
en: The sound of that king of conchs, as well as those of the Sārnga, combined with the roars emitted by Vişņu himself, swallowed up the roars of the Rākşasas.

sa: निरुत्साहस्य दीनस्य शोकपर्याकुलात्मनः। सर्वार्था व्यवसीदन्ति व्यसनं चाधिगच्छति॥
en: Of a person that is dispirited and poor in pluck and that has his soul overwhelmed with grief, every interest droops, and he comes by misfortunes (one after another).

sa: अवध्यतां तपोभिर्या भवान् समनुपश्यति। आत्मनः सासुरैर्देवैर्हेतुस्तत्राप्ययं महान्॥
en: You deem yourself by virtue of your asceticism incapable of being destroyed by the celestials and Asuras; and herein your great merit (incident to they austerities) is the cause.

sa: वेडितास्फोटितानां वै संचचालेव मेदिनी॥ रक्षसां सिंहनादैश्च संस्फोटितमिवाम्बरम्।
en: The earth shook as they sent up leonine roars and struck at their arms with their hands; and the sky seemed riven with the leonine roars of the Rākşasa.

sa: स तु मोहात्सुसंक्रुद्धं कृतान्तबलचोदितः। क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो रावणः सूतमब्रवीत्॥
en: After gradually regaining his senses, Rāvana, urged on by the force of the Finisher, getting into a furious passion, with his eyes reddened in wrath, addressed the charioteer, saying.

sa: इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया। मामैक्षत ततो रुष्टश्चक्षुषा प्रदहनिव॥
en: With these words the king of the monkeys has despatched me to you. And thereupon he eyed me as if burning me with the looks of his angry eyes.

sa: तान्काञ्चनान्वृक्षगणान्मारुतेन प्रकम्पितान्। किङ्किणीशतनिर्घोषान्दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागमत् ॥ सुपुष्पिताग्रान् रुचिरांस्तरुणाङ्कुरपल्लवान्।
en: Having seen those beautiful golden trees, shaken by the wind and making a sound like that of a Kinkini; having flowery tops and new leaves he was greatly amazed.

sa: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवं जगत्पतिम्। एतत्रिगुणितं जप्त्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यति॥
en: Do you with concentration, worship this god of gods, this lord of the universe. By reciting (this hymn) instinct with the three virtues, you will obtain victory in battle.

sa: संगच्छ शूलमादाय पाशहस्त इवान्तकः। वानरानराजपुत्रौ च भक्षयादित्यतेजसौ॥
en: Go forth, grasping your spear, like the noosehanded Destroyer himself. Do you devour up the monkeys as well as the princes possessed of the energy of the Sun himself.

sa: तेषां तु रथघोषेण राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्। वानराणामपि चमूर्युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत।।
en: By the wheel-sound of the chariots of the great Raksasas the host of monkeys calling each other, excited with anger and willing to gain victory, addressed themselves for fight.

sa: तेनोरसि निबद्धेन हारेण महता कपिः। रराज हेमशैलेन्द्रश्चन्द्रेणाक्रान्तमस्तकः॥
en: Like to the mountain Sumeru beautified by the rising of the moon on its summit, Hanumān, the foremost of monkeys, appeared graceful with the chain placed on his breast.

sa: करेणुहस्तप्रतिमः सव्यश्चोरुरनुत्तमः। वेपन् कथयतीवास्या राघवं पुरतः स्थितम्॥
en: And her excellent beautiful left thigh, resembling the trunk of an elephant, is also dancing as if indicating, that she shall at no distant date, be reconciled to Rāghava.

sa: डिण्डिमं परिगृह्यान्या तथैवासक्तडिण्डिमा। प्रसुप्ता तरुणं वत्समुपगुह्येव भामिनी॥
en: Another woman was sleeping soundly, embracing her dindima,* with another, bound at her back; like a female taking both her lover and her child. *A kind of musical instrument.

sa: अचिन्तयित्वा बाणौघाशरीरे पातितान्कपिः। अकम्पनवधार्थाय मनो दध्ने महाबलः॥
en: And without casting a thought on the showers of arrows poured on his person, that monkey gifted with exceeding strength, set his heart on compassing the death of Akampana.

sa: राजा दशरथो नाम रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान्। पितेव बन्धुर्लोकस्य सुरेश्वरसमद्युतिः॥
en: King Dasaratha, master of cars and elephants and steeds, is the friend of all like to their father, and is furnished with the splendour of the sovereign of celestials.

sa: परस्परं घ्नतोस्तत्र वानरासुरयोस्तदा। आसीद्धीनोऽसुरो युद्धे शक्रसूनुर्व्यवर्धत ॥
en: Thus there was a skirmish between the monkey chief and the Asura. And in this conflict Asura's strength was greatly reduced, while that of Sakra's son was highly enhanced.

sa: महार्हमणिपत्रैश्च काञ्चनप्रभकेसरैः॥ नीलोत्पलवनैश्चित्रैः स देशः सर्वतो वृतः।
en: And that tract is every where filled with costly gems, and jewels, and woods of blue lotuses, having filaments splendid like gold; and with round pearls and costly jewels.

sa: बलादस्मिन् समागम्य मन्त्रिभिः पुरवासिभिः॥ राजभावे नियुक्तोऽहं शून्यदेशजिगीषया।
en: With the view of preventing any one to wish to conquer this kingdom vacant (of its ruler the citizens and counsellors unanimously, by force, entrusted me with regal authority.

sa: पूर्वमर्थं प्रतिश्रुत्य प्रतिज्ञां हातुमिच्छसि। राघवाणामयुक्तोऽयं कुलस्यास्य विपर्यय॥
en: Having promised me first, you endeavour to renounce that proinise of yours. This surely is unworthy of a descendant of Raghu, and this can bring destruction upon the dynasty.

sa: विदित्वा तु महाबाहुरमुत्रापि महाबलः। आनेष्यति पराक्रम्य वैवस्वतहृतामपि॥
en: Even if I am taken away by Yama, and if the mighty-armed Rāma is apprised of it, surely shall he bring me back by the display of his prowess.

sa: श्रेयसे वृद्धये तातं पुनरागमनाय च। गच्छस्वारिष्टमव्यग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्॥
en: Do you, my darling, with the view of attaining welfare here and hereafter and auspicious fortune, go calmly your fearless way, so that you may return hither (in time.)

sa: अभिज्ञानं कुरुष्व त्वमात्मनो वानरेश्वर। येन त्वामभिजानीयां द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतम्॥
en: Do you make some mark on your person, O lord of monkeys, by which I shall be able to recognize you when engaged in a duel (with your brother).

sa: ऋष्यमूकस्य गमनं सुग्रीवेण समागमम्। प्रत्ययोत्पादनं सख्यं वालिसुग्रीवविग्रहम्॥
en: The former's sojourn to the Rşyamūka, and meeting with Sugrīva; Rāma's raising the confidence of Sugrīva and his friendship with the latter; and the encounter between Vāli and Sugriva.

sa: कुलीनः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तेजस्वी चरितव्रतः। राज्यहेतोः कथं पापमाचरेन्मद्विधो जनः॥
en: Of a high race, possessed of strength, endowed with energy, and vowed to sterling worth of character, how can one like me commit sin for the sake of dominion?

sa: सोऽहमिक्ष्वाकुभिः सर्वैनरेन्द्रैः प्रतिपालितम्। श्रेयसा योक्तुमिच्छामि सुखार्हमखिलं जगत्॥
en: Now it is my intention to bring welfare to this entire earth worthy of being rendered happy, which had been governed by all those sovereigns, Ikşvāku and the rest.

sa: सर्वैरेव समागम्य वागियं समुदाहृता। राक्षसैर्दण्डकारण्ये बहुभिः कामरूपिभिः॥
en: Thereat all those that had come, said, We have been, O Rāma, immensely harassed in the forest of Dandaka by Räkşasas wearing shapes at will. Do you deliver us.

sa: केनेदमुपदिष्टं ते क्षुद्रेणाहितबुद्धिना। यस्त्वामिच्छति नश्यन्तं स्वकृतेन निशाचर॥
en: What little-minded man of evil intent has counselled you thus? O Ranger of night, really do they desire that you do bring destruction upon yourself by your own actions.

sa: त्वमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्यास्य पृथिव्याश्च महारथः। प्रधानश्चापि नाथश्च देवानां मघवानिव॥
en: A mighty car-warrior, you are the foremost person of the lkshvāku race and the world; as well as their lord, even as Maghavān is the lord of the celestials.

sa: महिषो दुन्दुभिर्नाम कैलासशिखरप्रभः। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: There was one assuming the shape of buffalo named Dundubhi, resembling in splendour the summit of Kailasa. That one possessed of prowess had the strength of an hundred elephants.

sa: तुषारपतनाच्चैव मृदुत्वाद् भास्करस्य च। शैत्यादगाग्रस्थमपि प्रायेण रसवज्जलम्॥
en: What on account of the snow-fall, what of the mildness of the sun, and what through the cold, water even when it is on a mountain top, tastes sweet.

sa: पुत्रशोकार्दितं पापा विसंज्ञं पतितं भुवि। विचेष्टमानमुत्प्रेक्ष्य ऐक्ष्वाकमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then that sinful woman, seeing the descendant of Ikşvāku distressed on account of his son, and deprived of consciousness, and lying inert on the ground, spoke to him, saying.

sa: तस्मिन्नार्जवसम्पन्ने देवि देवोपमे कथम्। पापमाशंससे रामे महर्षिसमतेजसि॥
en: How, O respected one, can you ask for this that will bring you sin, touching Rāma endowed with candour, and energetic like to a Maharsi, and resembling a celestial?

sa: महार्हवस्त्रसम्बद्धो भूत्वा चिरसुखोचितः। काषायपरिधानस्तु कथं रामो भविष्यति॥
en: How will he, who has always been clad in costly attire, and who has always enjoyed happiness, will dwell on the bare earth, wearing a piece of red cloth?

sa: बहवः साधवो लोके युक्तधर्ममनुष्टिताः। परेषामपराधेन विनष्टाः सपरिच्छदाः॥
en: Many a pious person, on this earth, ever engaged in the performance of religious services, have, for the folly of other persons, met with destruction along with their relatives.

sa: कच्चित् सहस्रैर्मूर्खाणामेकमिच्छसि पण्डितम्। पण्डितो ह्यर्थकृच्छेषु कुर्यानिःश्रेयसं महत्॥
en: And passing by a thousand dunces, do you set your heart on having a single wise man? In times of pecuniary stress, a wise man stands in excellent stead.

sa: पूजा प्रयुज्यतामाशु मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। ऋषीछान्तनवो दृष्ट्वा सभाद्वारमुपस्थितान्॥
en: Arrange therefore immediately for the worship of these Munis who have conquered their souls.” The son of Shantanu seeing the Rishis come at the very gates of the AssemblyHall.

sa: अपरे पुरुषव्याघ्राः सहस्राक्षौहिणीसमाः। सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च यमौ च सुमहाबलौ॥
en: There are others, best among men, who are, each of them equal to thousand Akshauhinis-for instance, the son of Satyaki, Bhimasena and the twin brothers of very great strength.

sa: त्वयोच्यमानाः कुरुषु राजमध्ये परंतप। भीष्मद्रोणादयश्चैव विदुरश्च महामतिः॥
en: Bhishma, Drona and others as also the greatly intelligent Vidura and yourself, O you tiger among the race of the Yadus, will be assembled together in the Council Chamber.

sa: संध्यामुपास्य ध्यायन्तस्तमेव गतमानसाः। आनाय्य कृष्णं दाशार्ह पुनमन्त्रममन्त्रयन्॥
en: Having said their evening prayers began to think of him (Krishna) with their minds fixed on him, and getting Krishna of the Dasharha race, they again held a consultation.

sa: अलमर्धं पृथिव्यास्ते सहामात्यस्य जीवितुम्। प्रयच्छ पाण्डुपुत्राणां यथोचितमरिंदम॥
en: One half of the earth is sufficient for the livelihood of yourself and your ministers. Give back to the sons of Pandu their dues, O you subduer of enemies.

sa: युक्ताश्चान्यैहादोषैर्ये नरास्तान् विवर्जयेत्। निवर्तमाने सौहार्दे प्रीतिर्नीचे प्रणश्यति॥
en: Those men who are endued with similar other great vices should be avoided. In the absence of (the cause of) friendship, the good feeling towards the low is destroyed.

sa: बाहुवीर्यार्जिता भूमिस्तव पार्थेनिवेदिता। मयेदं कृतमित्येव मन्यसे राजसत्तम॥
en: The kingdom acquired by their arms and prowess was made over to you by the Parthas and you think, "it has been acquired by me," O best of kings.

sa: माद्रीसुताभ्यामुक्ते तु स्वमते कुरुनन्दनः। वासविर्वासवसमः सव्यसाच्यब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: The two sons of Madri having spoken out their own opinions, that delighter of the Kuru race, Savyasachin, the son of Vasava, equal to Vasava himself, said these words.

sa: आसाद्य तु सभाद्वारमृषभः सर्वसात्वताम्। अवतीर्य रथाच्छौरिः कैलासशिखरोपमात्॥
en: Shauri, the best among the entire Satvata race, coming to the gate of the Assembly-Hall, got down from the car which was like the peak of the Kailasa mountain.

sa: नभः सूर्यमिवोद्यन्तं कौन्तेयं दीप्ततेजसम्। पञ्चालाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति तेजोराशिमिवोदितम्॥
en: The Panchalas like a cluster of rays gladden the heart of the son of Kunti, who is of effulgent prowess, like the sun rising making the sky look cheerful.

sa: पितृहीनमपि ह्येनं गुणतो वरयामहे। बहमानाच्च भवतस्तथैवैरावतस्य च॥
en: Though he is without a father, yet for his accomplishment, do we select him and for the great respect in which yourself and the Airavata race generally are held.

sa: ततः सुपत्रं सुमुखं हेमपुल शरोत्तमम्॥ तूणादादाय काकुत्स्थो ब्रह्मास्त्रेण युयोज ह। तं बाणवर्यं रामेण ब्रह्मास्त्रेणानुमन्त्रितम्॥ जहषुर्देवगन्धर्वा दृष्ट्वा शक्रपुरोगमाः। अल्पावशेषमायुश्च ततोऽमन्यन्त रक्षसः॥ ब्रह्मास्त्रोदीरणाच्छनोर्देवदानवकिन्नराः।
en: Thereupon, the descendant. of Kakustha, taking from his quiver an excellent arrow arrow adorned with beautiful feathers, golden wings and a beautiful face adjusted it to the Brahma weapon. When Rama inspired that arrow with the Mantras peculiar to the weapon of Brahma. All the celestials and the Gandharvas with Indra at their head were highly delighted. The gods, the Danavas and the Kinnaras, seeing the display of that Brahma weapon began to consider that a little only of their Rakshasa enemy's life was left to him.

sa: धर्षिताः काममन्युभ्यां क्रोधलोभवशानुगाः। इमं हि पुण्डरीकाक्षं जिघृक्षन्त्यल्पचेतसः॥
en: Being overpowered by desire and wrath and being subjected to the influence of anger and avarice, these men, of mean heart, seek to slay the one with lotus eyes,

sa: जननी कश्यपः पिता। अहमप्युत्सहे लोकान् समन्ताद् वोदुमञ्जसा॥
en: O too have daughter of Daksha for my mother and Kashyapa also for my father and I too can venture to bear easily the weight of the three worlds.

sa: ततस्तं वैष्णवे शूरं नक्षत्रेऽभिमतेऽहनि। वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च सहितावभ्यषिञ्चताम्॥
en: Then Vasishtha together with Vamadeva installed that hero, at the eighth muhurta (a muhurta is equal to two dandas that is 4 minutes), of day under the constellation Shravana.

sa: योऽहमज्ञानसम्मोहादज्ञया सम्प्रवृत्तवान्। ससङ्गयाहं नि:सङ्गः स्थितः कालमिमं त्वहम्॥
en: Through Ignorance and stupefaction, I have becoine associated with Inanimate Nature. Though really shorn of attachments, I have passed this long time in a state of attachment with Nature.

sa: अत्रोच्यते-शारीरैर्मानसैर्दुःखैः सुखैश्चाप्यसुखोदयैः। लोकसृष्टिं प्रपश्यन्तो न मुह्यन्ति विचक्षणाः॥
en: Seeing that the world is stricken with physical and mental pain and with pleasures are that sure to end in misery, the wise never suffer themselves to be stupefied.

sa: रात्रिरेतावती चास्य प्रतिबुद्धो नराधिप। सृजत्योषधिमेवाग्रे जीवनं सर्वदेहिनाम्॥
en: The duration of his night is equal. When his night passes, he awakes, O king, and first crcates herbs and plants which form the sustenance of all embodied creatures.

sa: यास्यसि ब्रह्मणः स्थानमनिमित्तमनिन्दितम्। साधये भविता चैतद् यत्त्वयाहमिहार्थिता॥
en: You shall go to the region of Brahma which is incrcate and free from every fault. I go hence, but that which you have asked me shall take place.

sa: बिन्दुन्यासादयोऽवस्थाः शुक्रशोणितसम्भवाः। यासामेव निपातेन कललं नाम जायते॥
en: Embryonic conditions are due to the mixture of the vital seed and blood. On account of insemination the result which first appears is called by the name of 'Kalala.

sa: कृत्या ह्येता घोररूपा मोहयन्त्यविचक्षणान्। रजस्यन्तर्हिता मूर्तिरिन्द्रियाणां सनातनी॥
en: Indeed, women are like dreadful Mantra powers. They stupefy persons shorn of wisdom. They are sunk in the quality of Darkness. They are the eternal embodiment of the senses.

sa: तस्मिन्नाकुशलं ब्रूयान्न शुष्कामीरयेद् गिरम्। क्षत्रियो बाहुवीर्येण तरेदापदमात्मनः॥
en: No abusive word or dry speeches, should be spoken to a Brahmana. The Kshatriya should get over all his difficulties by the help of the power of his arms.

sa: तपोभिर्यज्ञदानैश्च वाक्यैः प्रज्ञाश्रितैस्तथा। प्राप्नोत्यभयदानस्य यद् यत् फलमिहाश्नुते॥
en: Whatever fruits one enjoys by penances, by sacrifices, by making charities, by speaking the truth, and by seeking wisdom, may all be acquired by practising the duty of harmlessness.

sa: स्वधर्मः परिपाल्यस्तु राज्ञामिति विनिश्चयः। विप्रधर्मश्च गहनो मामनात्मानमाविशत्॥
en: It is settled that kings should follow the duties sanctioned for them. To my misfortune, however, the course of duties laid down for Brahmanas has affected my wretched self.

sa: प्रतिरूपतराः केचिद् दृश्यन्ते बुद्धिमत्तराः। विरूपेभ्योऽल्पबुद्धिभ्यो लिप्समाना धनागमम्॥
en: Some extraordinary persons again are seen, for though possessed of superior intelligence they have to seek wealth from others that are vulgar in features and gifted with little intelligence.

sa: सुखस्पर्शः सत्त्वगुणो दुःखस्पर्शो रजोगुणः। तमोगुणेन संयुक्तौ भवतोऽव्यावहारिकौ॥
en: The quality of goodness brings happiness; the quality of Darkness produces sorrow; and if these two combine with the quality of Ignorance then neither happiness nor sorrow is produced.

sa: तस्य तात वधात् सर्वे देवदानवमानवाः। मधुसूदनमित्याहुर्ऋषभं सर्वसात्वताम्॥
en: For slaying this demon, O son, all the gods and the Danavas and men called that foremost of all righteous person by the name of Madhusudana (slayer of Madhu).

sa: ब्रह्मर्षे विदितश्चासि विषयान्तमुपागतः। गुरोस्तव प्रसादेन तव चैवोपशिक्षया॥
en: O regenerate Rishi, I am convinced that through the mercy of your preceptor and through the instructions you have received, you have already transcended all objects of the senses.

sa: मनश्च प्रथितं राजन् पञ्चेन्द्रियसमीरणम्। एष लोकविधिधीमानेष लोकविसर्गकृत्॥
en: He is the Mind, O king, that directs and governs the five senses. Gifted with the highest intelligence, He is the Ordainer of the universe, and the Creator thereof.

sa: ततो विश्रान्तमासीनं गोत्रप्रश्नमपृच्छत। सोऽब्रवीद् गौतमोऽस्मीति ब्रह्म नान्यदुदाहरत्॥
en: Seeing his guest seated at his ease, he asked him about his birth. The man answered, saying, I am a Brahmana by the name of Gautama!-and then became silent.

sa: यथावद् वर्तमानानां वृद्धानां पुत्रपौत्रिणाम्। अनुवर्तामहे वृत्तमहिंस्राणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: I follow the practices of great and benevolent men of advanced years who with their children and grand children live observing duly the ordinance laid down in the scritptures.

sa: नाप्राप्यं तपसः किंचित् त्रैलोक्येऽपि परंतप। उपभोगपरित्यागः फलान्यकृतकर्मणाम्॥
en: There is nothing in the three worlds, O scorcher of enemies, that penances cannot bring in. Even those who are shorn of true knowledge acquire Renunciation through their penances.

sa: शीलयौवनतस्त्वन्यस्तथान्यः सिद्धसाध्ययोः। ऋभवो मरुतश्चैव देवानां चोदितो गणः॥
en: The Siddhas and the Saddhyas were divided into two classes for their conduct and youth. The deities were formerly divided into two classes, viz., the Ribhus and the Maruts.

sa: अनया हतमेवेदमिति शास्त्रमपार्थकम्। दैतेयानुशना प्राह संशयच्छेदनं पुरा॥
en: In days of yore, Ushanas said to the Daityas this truth, which dispels all doubts, that scriptures are no scriptures if they cannot stand the crucible test of reason.

sa: त्रेतायुगे भविष्यामि रामो भृगुकुलोद्वहः। क्षत्रं चोत्सादयिष्यामि समृद्धबलवाहनम्॥
en: In the Treta age I shall take birth as Rama in the race of Bhrigu, and root out the Kshatriyas who will become proud of their strength and riches.

sa: नैषां पश्यामि हन्तारं प्राणिनां संयुगे परम्। विक्रमेणोपसम्पन्नास्तेजोबलसमन्विताः॥
en: I do not see any one else that could kill any of these men in battle. All of them were gifted with great prowess, great energy, and great strength.

sa: एवमुक्तः सहस्राक्षो भगवान् पाकशासनः॥ प्रतिसंहृत्य संरम्भमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः।
en: Thus addressed by the kings of the Daityas, the god of a hundred sacrifices, viz., the powerful and thousand-eyed chastiser of Paka, checked his anger and said these words.'

sa: पौरेषु विनिवृत्तेषु विदुरः सत्यधर्मवित्। बोधयन् पाण्डवश्रेष्ठमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: When the citizens had left (the Pandavas), Vidura, learned in all the precepts of virtue, thus spoke to the eldest Pandava in order to want him (of his danger.)

sa: जिष्णोः सहभ्रातुरचिन्त्यकर्मा। दामोदरो भ्रातरमुग्रवीर्य हलायुधं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Seeing the feats of both Jishnu (Arjuna) and his brother, Damodara (Krishna) of superhuman intelligence and in conceivable feats, spoke thus to his brother Halayudha (Balarama) of fearful energy.

sa: मुहुर्मुहुश्च वैदेही परिदाय महायशाः। स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः पुनरायान्महातपाः॥
en: Having consigned the charge of Sītā to the hands of the female ascetics, the great and illustrious ascetic Vālmīki, followed by his disciples, speedily proceeded towards his holy hermitage.

sa: अर्जुनेनैवमुक्तस्तु द्रोणो हृष्टतनूरुहः। मुञ्चस्वेत्यब्रवीत् पार्थं स मुमोचाविचारयन्॥
en: Having been thus told by Arjuna, Drona was filled with delight and his hair stood on their end. He told Partha, "Shoot,” and he instantly let fly (the arrow).

sa: कुलतन्तुर्हि नः शिष्टस्त्वमेवैकस्तपोधन। यस्त्वं पश्यसि नो ब्रह्मवीरणस्तम्बमाश्रितान्॥
en: O Rishi, O holy man, you are the only thread in the line of your ancestors.” O Brahmana, the Virana root that you see and on which we hang,

sa: ऋष्यशृङ्गस्य चरितं कौमारब्रह्मचारिणः। जामदग्न्यस्य रामस्य चरितं भूरितेजसः॥
en: It then tells the story of Rishyashringa who adopted the life of an ascetic from his boyhood. Then follows the story of greatly powerful Rama, the son of Jamadagni,

sa: तमागतमभिश्रुत्य भीष्मं वाह्रीकपुङ्गवः। प्रत्युद्गम्यार्चयित्वा च पुरं प्रावेशयन्नृपः॥
en: That best of Valhikas (the king of Madra), having heard of his coming, went out to receive him with all honour; and that king (Bhishma) also entered his capital.

sa: यत्र विख्यातकीर्तिः स कुरूणामृषभोऽभवत्। स राजा मन्मथाविष्टस्तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: Where that best of the Kurus, the king of celebrated achievements, was. That king who had been possessed of desire and whose heart was completely fixed on her (Tapati)

sa: रुरुदुर्वारणाश्चैव तथा मृगतरक्षवः। तेन शब्देन वित्रेसुर्गङ्गोदधिचरा झषाः॥
en: Elephants, deer and wolves all wept and set up cries of affliction. At the sound the fishes that lived in the waters of the Ganges and the sea.. one

sa: गुरुशास्त्रेऽनिबद्धानामन्योऽन्येनाभिशंकिनाम्। नियन्तुं न हि शक्यस्त्वं भेदतो धनमिच्छसि॥
en: Who, when divided, do not have any regard for Shastras or Gurus. As you, without regarding my advice, impelled by the desire of separation, wish to partition for wealth,

sa: तदेतैर्विविधैर्लिङ्गैस्त्वं विद्यास्तं द्विजोत्तमम्। भूतानामग्रभूविप्रो वर्णश्रेष्ठः पिता गुरुः॥
en: You must know a good Brahmana by these indications. A Brahmana is the first-born of all creatures, the best of four castes, the father, master and teacher of all.

sa: यस्तु नोच्छेदनं चक्रे कुशिकानामुदारधीः। विश्वामित्रापराधेन धारयन् मन्युमुत्तमम्॥
en: Though the excellent Rishi's anger was excited by Vishvamitra, though he was afflicted at the loss of his sons, though he was powerful, yet he appeared to be powerless.

sa: मद्रराजस्य शल्यस्य ध्वजाग्रेऽग्निशिखामिव॥ सौवर्णी प्रतिपश्याम सीतामप्रतिमां शुभाम्।
en: The ruler of the Madras, we beheld, had on his standard-top, the unequalled and charming device of a plough-share, made of gold and looking like a flame of fire.

sa: द्रोणपुक्षस्य विक्रान्तं राधेयस्यैव चोभयोः। पश्यन्तु पाण्डुपुत्रास्ते विष्णुवासवयोरिव॥
en: Do you behold today the prowess of both the son of Drona and the son of Radha who are high-souled, among the troops of the Pandus and the Panchalas.

sa: शार्ङ्गगाण्डीवधन्वानौ सहितावपराजितौ। अहं दिव्याद् रथादेकः पातयिष्यायमि संयुगे॥
en: 'In the field of battle, alone I shall hurl down at once both the wielder of Gandiva bow, who are unconquerable and are united together, from their celestial cars.'

sa: विमुक्तौ शस्त्रसम्बाधाद् द्रोणानीकात् सुदुर्भिदात्। अदृश्येतां महात्मानौ कालसूर्याविवोदितौ॥
en: Having passed through that impenetrable array of Drona impassable in consequence of showers of weapons, those two illustrious heroes looked like two suns risen at the period of Dissolution.

sa: व्याघ्राविव नरव्याघ्रौ दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम्। शरधारासृजौ वीरौ मेघाविव ववर्षतुः॥
en: Assailing each other like two tigers fighting with their teeth, those two foremost of men poured their showers of arrows on each other like two mighty clouds pouring rain.

sa: इति कृष्णौ महेष्वासौ प्रशस्तौ लोकविश्रुतौ। सर्वभूतान्यमन्यनत द्रोणास्त्रबलवारणात्॥
en: All human beings began to assume Sri Krishna and Arjuna, great archer, meritorious and renowned world-wide as they had effaced the destructive power of the weapon shot by Dronacarya.

sa: शतानीकं महाराज श्रुतकर्मा सुतस्तव। व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे निमेषार्धादसम्भ्रमः॥
en: O mighty monarch, your son, Srutakarman, deprived, without any fear, Shatanika of his horses, charioteer and car within half the time taken up by the twinkling on an eye.

sa: मारुतोद्भूतवेगस्य सागरस्येव पर्वणि। तानभिद्रवतः सर्वान् समीक्ष्य शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Resembling the roar of the ocean in a Parva-day when it is lashed into fury by the wind. Beholding them all rush towards himself, that foremost of then Sinis.

sa: सीदन् रुधिरसिक्तश्च रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। सूतेनापहृतस्तूर्णं द्रोणपुत्राद् रथान्तरम्॥
en: And steeped in blood and loosing strength he squatted down on the terrace of his car. His driver then quickly drove him away from the vicinity of Drona's son.

sa: धनुरेकेन भल्लेन हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः॥ ध्वजं च रथशक्तिं च भल्लाभ्यां परमास्त्रवित्। चिच्च्द विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तथोभौ पार्णिसारथी॥
en: Versed in the use of many excellent weapons Satyaki then cut-off Dushasana's bow with a single bhalla, his gloves with five and his chariot and chariot shaft, with a couple of broad-headed arrows with sharp shafts he cutoff his two Parshni drivers. Then Dushasana, deprived of his car, with his bow burst open, his charioteer and steeds slain.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण द्रोणं विव्याध पार्थिवः। साश्वसूतध्वजरथं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then with a thousand shafts, the son of Pandu pierced Drona together with his horses, charioteer, standard and car and this (feat on the part of Yudhishthira) seemed marvellous.

sa: नकुलेन शरा मुक्ताः कङ्कबहिणवाससः। सूतपुत्रमवच्छाद्य व्यतिष्ठन्त यथाम्बरे॥
en: The arrows that were furnished with the Kanka, the peacock feathers and garments, shot by Nakula, after having closed the son of Suta, appeared to stay on the sky.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य द्रोणमभ्याशमागतम्। असिचर्मादद वीरो धनुरुत्सृज्य भारत॥
en: Grasped his sword and mace and that hero, O Bharata, left aside his bow. Then that slayer of hostile heroes viz., Prishatas son, desirous of achieving a difficult feat.

sa: संरब्धौ हि महाबाहु परस्परवधैषिणौ। अन्योन्यमीक्षांचक्राते दहन्ताविव लोचनैः॥
en: Filled with wrath and desirous of slaying one another, O mighty-armed one, they began to look at each other as if to burn each other down with their giances.

sa: ततः शरशतेनाजौ धर्मपुत्रमवाकिरत्। कवचं चास्य संक्रुद्धः शरैस्तीक्ष्णौरदारयत्॥
en: Then, in that encounter, he covered the son of Dharma with hundreds of shafts; (and then), inflamed with ire he cut-off the armour of (Yudhishthira) with showers of arrows.

sa: शतानीकमथायान्तं मद्रराजो महामृधे। विशिखैर्बहुभिर्विद्ध्वा ततो निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: That lord of the earth, that is, the king of Madra, having with numerous shafts pierced Shatanika who was advancing (against him), sent him to the abode of Yama.

sa: मार्कण्डेयः पुराणर्षिश्चरितज्ञस्तवानघ। माहात्म्यमनुभावं च पुरा कीर्तितवान् मुनिः॥
en: O innocent Sri Krishna! An ancient sage Markandeya knows yours character and that brilliant sage had explained me your impression and magnificence to me at the time of exile.

sa: सोऽहमेतादृशो भूत्वा नेहारिबलसूदनः। सूतपुत्रस्य संग्रामे सारथ्यं कर्तुमुत्सहे॥
en: O slayer of the hostile force, when I am such a person as described, I cannot dare act as the charioteer of the son of Suta in the field.

sa: शरैरग्न्यर्कसंकाशैः प्रदुद्राव समन्ततः। तस्मिन्हते गजानीके जलसन्धो महाबलः॥
en: With his arrows that resembled the sun or the fire, began to fly away in all directions. When that elephant division was being thus slaughtered, the highly powerful Jalasandha.

sa: पुण्डरीकवनानीव विध्वस्तानि समन्ततः। चक्राते द्रोणपाञ्चाल्यौ नृणां शीर्षाण्यनेकशः॥
en: Like a forest of lotuses lying torn hither and hither, the heads of princes were being scattered all over the field by Drona and the prince of the Panchalas.

sa: निपेतुर्द्विरदा भूमौ सशृङ्गा इव पर्वताः॥ निकृत्तैर्हस्तिहस्तैश्च विचलद्भिरितस्ततः।
en: The tuskers fell down on earth like mountains devoid of (their) peaks with the trunks of elephants chopped off (by arrows) that were still moving about here and there.

sa: किरन् बाणगणान् राजशतशोऽर्जुनमूर्धनि। अतितीवं महद् युद्धं नरराक्षसयोस्तदा॥
en: By incessant discharges of arrows, O king, on the head of Arjuna. The battle that commenced between the man (i.e. Arjuna) and the Rakshasa was exceedingly hot and furious.

sa: प्रहृष्टमनसं ज्ञात्वा वासुदेवं महाबलः। अर्जुनोऽथाब्रवीद् राजन्नातिहृष्टमना इव॥
en: That undeteriorating god, endowed with great intelligence, once more uttered roud roars standing on the terrace of his car. Then beholding those sings of joy manifested by Kesava, Dhananjaya.

sa: अमृष्यमाणयोः संख्ये देवदानवयोरिव। क्षीणशस्त्रस्तु कौन्तेयः कर्णेन समभिद्रुतः॥
en: And who would not brook each other's feat, looked like that between the gods and the Danavas. His stock of weapons exhausted, Kunti's son (Bhima) was assailed by Karna.

sa: घटोत्कचस्ततो मायां ससर्जान्तर्हितः पुनः॥ सोऽभवद् गिरिरत्युचः शिखरैस्तरुसंकटैः।
en: Ghatotkacha then disappeared from view again and created (another) illusion (by virtue of this new illusion); he assumed the shape of a towering mountain abounding with peaks and trees.

sa: दुर्योधने परावृत्ते शैनेयस्तव वाहिनीम्। द्रावयामास विशिखैर्निशामध्ये विशाम्पते॥
en: When Duryodhana had been compelled to turn his face away from the battle, the grandson of Shini in that night began to crush your troops, O ruler of men.

sa: अमृष्यमाणास्तं शब्दं क्रुद्धाः परमधन्विनः। नानादेश्या महीपाला: स्वसैन्यपरिरक्षिणः॥
en: All great bow-men, inflamed with anger and unable to bear the loud blasts of Arjuna's and Krishna's conchs, those kings come from diverse countries and accompanied by their troops.

sa: ततो द्रौणिस्त्रिसप्तया वासुदेवमताडयत्। अर्जुनं च त्रिभिर्भल्लैर्ध्वजमश्वांश्च पञ्चभिः॥
en: Then the son of Drona pierced Vasudeva's son with seventy-three arrows and he also pierced Arjuna with three broad-headed shafts and the latter's steeds and standard with five arrows.

sa: तथैव वेदाश्चतुरो हयाग्र्या धरा सशैला च रथो महात्मनः। नक्षत्रवंशानुगतो वरूथी हरो योद्धा सारथि भिलक्ष्यः॥
en: So also, the four Vedas have become the four horses, the best of their species, of that high-souled Deity; and the Earih, among with the numerous mountains, had become his car. The equipments of that car were the constellations. The warrior (who will fight from that car) is Hara. But who will be the charioteer, is still unfound.

sa: निकृत्तभुजमासीनं छिन्नहस्तमिव द्विपम्। क्रोशतां सर्वसैन्यानां निन्द्यमानः सुदुर्मनाः॥
en: Who was sitting with his arm lopped off, like an elephant with his trunk cut-off. Then all the warriors reproached him loudly for his intention. But destitute of reason.

sa: द्वन्द्वान्यासन् महाराज प्रेक्षणीयानि संयुगे। विविधान्यप्यचिन्त्यानि शस्त्रवन्त्युत्तमानि त॥
en: Thus, O great monarch, several kinds of unthought encounters took place between heroes armed with the best of weapons, which were most beautiful to look at upon the field.

sa: अथ कार्मुकमादाय भीमो जलदनि:स्वनम्। रिपोरभ्यर्दयन्नागमुन्नदन् पाण्डवः शरैः॥
en: Then having taken up his bow having the twang like the roar of clouds, Bhima the son of Pandu, oppressed his enemy's elephant by arrows and uttered terrible shouts.

sa: सृञ्जयाश्चेतरे सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः॥ असकृन्निर्जिताः संख्ये स्मयमानेन संयुगे।
en: And several other heroes, namely all the Srinjayas, who headed by Dhrishtadyumna, often and often vanquished in the field by him, who felt the greatest ease in the battle.

sa: त्वं शल्यभूतः शत्रूणामविषह्यः पराक्रमे॥ ततस्त्वमुच्यसे राजशल्य इत्यरिसूदन।
en: O monarch, you are made up of shafts; and you are invincible in respect to your antagonists in prowess. O slayer of enemies, you are, therefore, called Shalya (shaft).

sa: तेषामासीद् व्यतिक्षेपौ गर्जतामितरेतरम्॥ दुर्योधनमुखानां च पाण्डूनामृषभस्य च।
en: Then roaring at one another they fall upon one another, headed as they were by Duryodhana on one side and by that foremost of the Pandavas on the other.

sa: तान् निवार्य शराशूरः शैनेयः कृतहस्तवत्। साश्वसूतध्वजं बाणैर्व्याघ्रदत्तमपातयत्॥
en: Then the heroic grandson of Sini baffling those arrows like one accomplished in the art of fighting, felled with his arrows Vyaghradatta together with his horses, charioteer and standard.

sa: दशभिर्दशभिश्चैतान् पुनर्विद्ध्वा ननाद च। साश्वसूतरथच्छत्रांस्ततस्ते विवरं ददुः॥
en: Once more striking each of them and his horses, drivers, car and flag with ten arrows he sent up a loud war-cry. His antagonist then gave him a way.

sa: तावेकरथमारूढावादत्याग्निसमत्विषौ॥ अभ्रजेतां यथा मेघ सूर्याग्नी सहितौ दिवि।
en: Seated on the same car those two horses. effulgent like the sun and fire, shone there like the sun and fire sitting together on a cloud in the sky.

sa: ततो विनिद्रा विश्रान्ताश्चन्द्रमस्युदिते पुनः। संसाधयिष्यथान्योन्यं संग्रामं कुरुपाण्डवाः॥
en: Then when the moon arises ye Kurus and the Pandavas, having taken rest and shaken off your fatigue, you may again meet one another in battle for securing paradise."

sa: इति तीर्थानुसारं राक्षसी काचिदब्रवीत्। एकरात्रशयी गेहे महोलूखलमेखला॥
en: A Rakshasa woman of huge hips, thus spoke to a Brahman, who once went to that country for bathing in a sacred water and passed a single night there.

sa: इदं तु नीचाचरितमसत्पुरुषसेवितम्। कथमाचरितं पार्थ पापकर्म सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Why then, O son of Pritha, have you perpetrated this vile and difficult deed, that is only worthy of a mean fellow and is practised only by wicked people.

sa: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम बाणभूते तथाविधे। न स्म सम्पतते भूतंकिंचिदेवान्तरिक्षगम्॥
en: When the sky was thus converted into one sheet of arrows it was a wonderful sight to look at. No creature could range in the sky at that time.

sa: युधिष्ठिरपुरोगास्तु द्रौणिशस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥ अभ्यवर्षन्त वेगेन विसृजन्तः शिताञ्छरान्।
en: Then the Pandava army commanded by Raja Yudhishthira, rushed furiously towards Drona's son, the foremost of all the wielders of weapons and began to shower sharp shafts upon him.

sa: ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणि प्रावाद्यन्त महामृधे॥ ततः किलाकिलाशब्दः प्रादुरासन् महीपते।
en: Thereupon in that dreadful battle thousands of trumpets were beaten; and after this, O mighty lord earth, a mixed noise, consisting of numerous voices, arose there (in the battle).

sa: अभ्यनन्दत् स राजर्षिः पुत्रवद् भरतर्षभान्। पूजिताश्चावसंस्तत्र सप्तरात्रमरिन्दमाः॥
en: The royal sage too welcomed those most exalted of the Bharatas as if they were his own children. Thus received, the tormentors of foes remained there for seven nights.

sa: वेदी प्रजापतेरेषा समन्तात् पञ्चयोजना। कुरोर्वै यज्ञशीलस्य क्षेत्रमेतन्महात्मनः॥
en: This is the altar of the Prajapati; it is five yojanas in extent on all sides round. This is the field of the high-souled Kurus who always performed sacrifices.

sa: धिक्शब्दस्तु ततस्तत्र समभूल्लोमहर्षणः। सभ्यानां नरदेवानां दृष्ट्वा कुन्तीसुतांस्तथा॥
en: Seeing the sons of Kunti in that state, all those gods among men who were present there cried hair stirring words of "Fie!” “Fie!” (on the son of Dhritarashtra).

sa: ततो मायास्त्रमास्थाय युयुधे चित्रमार्गवित्। तयामुह्यन्त कौरव्याचित्रसेनस्य मायया।॥
en: That hero, learned in the various modes of warfare, fought with his weapons of illusion. The Kuru heroes were all deprived of their senses by the illusion of Chitrasena.

sa: द्विषतां च प्रहर्षोऽभूदार्तिश्चाद्विषतामपि। एवं विजितवान् वीर पश्चादश्रौषमच्युत॥
en: O hero, O undeteriorating one, delight filled the hearts of the enemies as sorrow filled those of iny men. I heard of this after I had defeated the enemy.

sa: प्रमाणरागसम्पन्नान् वक्षुतीरसमुद्भवान्। बल्यर्थं ददतस्तस्मै हिरण्यं रजतं बहु॥
en: They were all of good size and delightful colour; they were all born on the coast and shore the Vanku, of all these kings gave much gold and silver.

sa: आजहस्तत्र सत्कृत्य स्वयमुद्यम्य भारत। अभिषेकार्थमव्यग्रा भाण्डमुच्चावचं नृपाः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, many kings with greatest alacrity themselves brought there many excellent jars(of water) for the purpose of bathing the king at the end of the sacrifice.

sa: तथैव मलदिग्धाङ्गी परिष्वज्य शुचिस्मिताम्। सुचिरं पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तस्थौ शोकपरिप्लुतः॥
en: That foremost of men, overwhelmed as he was with grief, stood in silence for some time, while embracing that lady of blameless smiles, who herself was covered with dust.

sa: एतावदेव विबुधा यथावृत्तमुपाहृतम्। मयाशेषे प्रमाणं तु भवन्तस्त्रिदशेश्वराः॥
en: O the exalted of gods, this is all, I relate to you what happened there. O the lords of the gods, it behoves, you therefore, to settle everything finally

sa: महता हि प्रयत्नेन संना गजवाजिभिः। अस्माभिर्यदनुष्ठेयं गन्धर्वैस्तदनुष्ठितम्॥
en: "That, we ought to have done with great efforts arriving ourselves in the line of battle, supported by horses and elephants has indeed been done (today) by the Gandharvas.

sa: बलीनां सम्यगादानाद् धर्मतश्चानुशासनात्। निकामवर्षी पर्जन्यः स्फीतो जनपदोऽभवत्॥
en: In consequence of the equitable taxation and the virtuous and the just rule of the king, the clouds poured as much rain as desired, and the country became prosperous.

sa: प्रदीयमानं देवैस्तं देवदत्तं जलोद्भवम्। प्रत्यगृहणं जयायैनं स्तूयमानस्तदामरैः॥
en: And then the gods presented to me this shell, Devadatta, having its origin in the sea. I too accepted it for victory. Then the immortals began to eulogise me.

sa: स्तस्मिन् वने मूलफलैरुदगः। द्विजातिमुख्यानृषभः कुरूणां संतर्पयामास महानुभावः॥
en: In that forest, that king, the foremost of the Kurus, began to please all the Yatis, Munis and all the leading Brahmanas by offering them excellent fruits and roots.

sa: गुहां संतत्यजुर्व्याघ्रो निलिल्युर्वनवासिनः। समुत्पेतुः खगास्त्रस्ता मृगयूथानि दुद्रुवुः॥
en: Tigers came out of their dens while other wild animals hid themselves in their own. The birds flew away in alarm and herds of deer ran (in all directions).

sa: ब्राह्मणास्तेऽन्वमोदन्त शिवेन कुशलेन च। सुखोदकमिमं क्लेशमचिराद् भरतर्षभ।॥
en: The Brahmanas then approved of the proposal in terms bespeaking happiness and prosperity, saying, "O the most exalted of all the Bharatas, these troubles shall soon end in prosperity.

sa: चिरेणाद्य मयाऽऽहारः प्राप्तोऽयमनुजस्तव। नाहमेनं विमोक्ष्यामि न चान्यमभिकाझये।॥
en: After a long period (of abstinence) I have got this your younger brother for my food. I will not (therefore) release him. Nor do I want any other meal.

sa: युक्तं तस्याप्रमेयस्य वीर्यसत्त्ववतो मया। समाश्वासयितुं भार्यां पतिदर्शनलालसाम्॥
en: It is my duty to console the wife of that immensely powerful one who is gifted with prowess and goodness, as she is most anxious for beholding her lord.

sa: तयोः सुतुमुलं युद्धं शाल्ववृष्णिप्रवीरयोः। समेता ददृशुर्लोका बलिवासवयोरिव॥
en: All the people (as spectators) locked at that battle between Shalva and that foremost of the Vrishni heroes (Pradyumna) which was like the battle between Vasava (Indra) and Bali.

sa: चितचैत्यो महातेजाधर्मान् प्राप्य च पुष्कलान्। शक्रस्यार्धासनं राजंल्लब्धवानमितद्युतिः॥
en: O king, that great, powerful and immeasurably effulgent king erected many sacred piles and performed greatly pious deeds, by which he obtained the privilege of sitting at Indra's side.

sa: व्रजन्तु भ्रातरस्तेऽमी यदि सत्याभिसंधिनः। मत्परित्राणजं धर्ममिहैव त्वमवाप्नुहि॥
en: If they are bound by the dictates of virtue, let these your (elder) brothers go. You earn that virtue which is the fruit of waiting upon me (a mother).

sa: आजहुर्ऋतवश्चापि सुगन्धीनि पृथक् पृथक्। तस्मिन् देवसमावाये सर्वभूतसमागमे॥ दिव्यवादित्रसंघुष्टे दिव्यस्त्रीचारणावृते। इन्द्रः पप्रच्छ देवेशमभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च॥ देवानां भगवन् कस्माल्लोकेशानां पितामह। उपरिष्टाद् गवां लोक एतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: The Seasons also, in their embodied forms, bore the fragrance of flowers peculiar to each, to that assemblage of celestials, that gathering of all creatures of the universe, where celestial maidens danced and sang in accompaniment with celestial music. In the midst of that assembly, Indra, saluting the Lord of all the celestial and bowing his head to him with respect, asked him, saying, I wish, O Grandfather, to know why the region of kine is higher, O holy one, than the region of the celestials themselves who are the lords of all the worlds.

sa: एवमेतेन मार्गेण पूर्वोक्तेन यथाविधि। अधीतवान् यथाशक्ति तथैव ब्रह्मचर्यवान्॥ स्वधर्मनिरतो विद्वान् सर्वेन्द्रिययतो मुनिः। गुरोः प्रियहिते युक्तः सत्यधर्मपरः शुचिः॥ गुरुणा समनुज्ञातो भुञ्जीतान्नमकुत्सयन्। हविष्यभैक्ष्यभुक् चापि स्थानासनविहारवान्॥
en: Properly studying thus to the best of his power, in the way described above, and likewise living as a Brahmacharin, one who performs the duties of his own order, endued with learning, observant of penances, and with all the senses under control, devoted to what is agreeable and beneficial to the preceptor, steady in practising the duty of truth, and always pure, should, with the permission of the preceptor, eat his food without decrying it. He should eat Havishya made from what is got in alms, and should stand, sit, and take exercise (as directed).

sa: अव्यक्तयोनिप्रभवो बुद्धिस्कन्धमयो महान्। महाहंकारविटप इन्द्रियाङ्करकोटरः॥ महाभूतविशालश्च विशेषयति शाखिनः। सदापत्रः सदापुष्पः शुभाशुभफलोदयः॥ आजीव्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मवृक्षः सनातनः। एनं छित्त्वा च भित्त्वा च तत्त्वज्ञानासिना बुधः॥ हित्वा सङ्गमयान् पाशान् मृत्युजन्मजरोदयान्। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Having the unmanifest for the seed of its origin, with the understanding for its trunk, with the great principle of egoism for its collection of boughs, with the senses for the cavities of its little sprouts, with the (five) great elements for its large branches, the objects of the senses for this smaller branches, with leaves that are ever present, with flowers that always embellish it, and with fruits both agreeable and disagreeable always produced, is the eternal tree of Brahma which forins the support of all creatures. Cutting and piercing that tree with knowledge of truth as the sword, the wise man, abandoning the fetters which are made of attachment and which cause birth, decrepitude, and death, and freeing himself from mineness and egoism, forsooth, becomes liberated.

sa: चतुर्विंशमसारं च षड्विंशस्य प्रबोधनात्। एष ह्यप्रतिबुद्धश्च बुध्यमानश्च तेऽनघ॥ प्रोक्तो बुद्धश्च तत्त्वेन यथाश्रुतिनिदर्शनात्। नानात्वैकत्वमेतावद् द्रष्टव्यं शास्त्रदर्शनात्॥
en: For understanding the twenty-sixth, the twenty-four principles seem to Individual soul to be unreal. I have thus told you, O sinless one, according to the indications of the Shrutis the nature of the Unintelligent, and of Individual Soul, as also of that which is Pure knowledge, agreeably to the truth. Guided by the scriptures, variety and oneness are thus to be understood.

sa: लुप्तायां तु प्रकृतौ येन कर्म निष्पादयेत् तत् परीप्सेद् विहीनः। प्रकृतिस्थश्चादि वर्तमान उभौ गौ भवतः संजयैतौ॥
en: With his means of livelihood gone, a destitute man ought to desire for such means as may enable him to perform such duties as are laid down for him. O Sanjaya; both the man whose means of livelihood is not gone and the one who is in distress, are culpable (if they act as if they are not what they are)O Sanjaya,

sa: अत्रादित्यो हयशिराः काले पर्वणि पर्वणि। उत्तिष्ठति सुवर्णाख्यो वाग्भिरापूरयञ्जगत्॥
en: Here the son of Aditi, with his head like that of the horse, on every festive occasion, rises up, making the world, called Suvarna, filled with the sound of Vedic hymns and mantras.

sa: विधिर्यः शिविरस्यासीत् पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। तद्विधानि नरेन्द्राणां कारयामास केशवः॥
en: The rulers, that were in force in connection with the encampment of the great souled Pandavas, were ordered also to be followed by Keshava in regard the encampment of other chiefs of men.

sa: स्ताभ्यां लभेच्छर्म तदा सुतो मे। मिन्द्राविष्णू दैत्यसेनां यथैव॥
en: If the dull-headed one dose not fight with these two then may my son fare well, otherwise will they burn up the Kurus as Indra and Vishnu did the army of the Daityas.

sa: द्यूतप्रमुखमाभाति कुरूणां व्यसनं महत्। मन्देनैश्चर्यकामेन लोभात् पापमिदं कृतम्॥
en: The great calamity of the Kurus beginning with the game at dice now stands out in bold relief; this wicked act has been done by that fool desiring for prosperity out of avarice.

sa: चतुष्पादस्त्वया धर्मश्चितो लोक्येन कर्मणा। अक्षयस्तव लोकोऽयं कीर्तिश्चैवाक्षया दिवि॥
en: The four Padas (the full amount) of virtue had been earned by you your worldly deeds and these regions were yours for an endless period and your renown in heaven too was eternal.

sa: साब्रवीत् कृष्णमासीनं कृतातिथ्यं युधां पतिम्। बाष्पगद्गदपूर्णेन मुखेन परिशुष्यता॥
en: She said to Krishna, the best of warriors who had seated himself after receiving the rites of hospitality, with her face dried up with woe and in a voice choked up with tears.

sa: अवश्यमेव नृपते राज्ञो विषयवासिभिः। प्रियाण्याचरितव्यानि तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: O lord of men, it is the certain duty of those who live in a king's dominion to do which is agreeable to that king, what is there then to be Sorry for?

sa: पुनश्च वर्धितं राज्यं स्वबलेन महात्मभिः। छद्मनापहृतं क्षुदैर्धार्तराष्ट्रैः ससौबलैः॥
en: Then again, the kingdom gained by the noble-minded ones through their own strength was taken away from them by a trick by the mean sons of Dhritarashtra united with the son of Subala.

sa: असंविभागी दुष्टात्मा कृतघ्नो निरपत्रपः। तादृड्नराधिपो लोके वर्जनीयो नराधिप॥
en: Who does not give to others their dues, who is of a vicious soul and ungrateful and who has no sense of shame-such a wretch should, O king, be avoided in this world.

sa: एवमेव कुले जाताः पावकोपमतेजसः। क्षमावन्तो निराकाराः काष्टेऽग्निरिव शेरते॥
en: In the same way, those born in high families have energy like that of fire. Of a forgiving nature, they betray no symptoms of wrath and remain still like fire in the woods.

sa: विचित्रायुधवर्मिण्या गङ्गयेव प्रवृद्धया। स समासाद्य वार्ष्णेयं योगानामीश्वरं प्रभुम्॥
en: And furnished with diverse sorts of amours and weapons resembled the Ganga when full. He, then coming to that scion of the Vrishni race who is the lord, the object of all devotion,

sa: यं हि त्वमनवद्याङ्गि तरलायतलोचने। प्रसक्तमभिवीक्षेथाः स कामवशगो भवेत्॥
en: O you of expanded eyes, of nimble glances, the person, on whom you endued with faultless limbs, will cast a look with desire, will surely fall a victim to the God of Love.

sa: योग इत्यथ सैन्यानां त्वरतां सम्प्रधावताम्॥ हयवारणशब्दाश्च नेमिघोषाश्च सर्वतः।
en: There was a speedy moving about among the soldiers all crying "Dravup" and there was everywhere the roar of elephants, the neighing of horses and the clatter of the wheels of the chariots.

sa: अप्रदानेन राज्यस्य शान्तिमस्मासु मार्गति। लुब्धः पापेन मनसा चरन्नसममात्मनः॥
en: Without restoring to us our kingdom ho wants peace with us; and the covetous man behaves by his sinful heart without impartiality towards those whose interests should be looked after by him equally.

sa: व्रजन्नेव तु बीभत्सुः सखायं पुरुषर्षभम्। अब्रवीत् परवीरनं दाशार्हमपराजितम्॥
en: Vibhatsu, too, as he proceeded along, said to his friend, that bull among men, that slayer of heroes on the enemy's side, that scion of the Dasharha race who has never been defeated.

sa: अधिरूढा नरव्याघ्रा नरवाहनमुत्तमम्। त्रय एते मया दृष्टाः पाण्डुरच्छत्रवाससः॥
en: These best among men ascending a vehicle by human beings which had nothing better than it, were seen by me with a white umbrella over their heads and with white robes on. were

sa: कृष्णमक्लिष्टकर्माणमासाद्यायं सुदुर्मतिः। तव पुत्रः सहामात्यः क्षणेन न भविष्यति॥
en: This son of Dhritarashtra of exceedingly wicked purposes, along with his advisers, will cease to exist in a moment when he comes against Krishna, who can do a work without the least trouble.

sa: श्रीमत्स्ववभृथाग्रयेषु चतुर्पु प्रतिबन्धुषु। मध्ये निपतितो राजा लोकपालोपमेषु सः॥
en: The lord, of the earth following the course of that smoke which was moving like the Ganga in heaven, came among those foremost of the performers of sacrifices who were his own relatives;

sa: सोऽन्तमाश्रित्य लोकानां नष्टसंज्ञो विचेतनः। न प्राज्ञायत देवेन्द्रस्त्वभिभूतः स्वकल्मषैः॥
en: Staying at the end of the worlds, he became deprived of his senses and consciousness and the chief of the gods overpowered with the weight of his own sins could not be recognised.

sa: तदागच्छ द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रयिष्याव गालव। नादत्त्वा गुरवे शक्यं कृत्स्नमर्थत्वयाऽऽसितुम्॥
en: Therefore do you come, O foremost among the twice-born, we shall consult together ( Galava; without giving to your preceptor the whole of the wealth promised by you, you cannot even sit down."

sa: रामं कमलपत्राक्षं तुष्टुवुः सर्वदेवताः। गन्धर्वाः पुष्पवर्षेच वाग्भिश्च त्रिदशालयाः॥
en: All the gods together with the Gandharvas and the inhabitants of the celestials regions delighted Rama gifted with eyes resembling lotus-petals by (chanting) hymns (in his praise) and showering flowers (over his head).

sa: घडिमान् पुरुषो जह्याद् भिन्नां नावमिवार्णवे। अप्रवक्तारमाचार्यमनधीयानमृत्विजम्॥ अरक्षितारं राजानं भार्यां चाप्रियवादिनीम्। ग्रामकामं च गोपालं वनकामं च नापितम्॥
en: These six should be avoided by a man like a broken boat in the sea; a tutor that cannot interpret the meaning of the holy books, a priest that is not well read, a king that cannot protect a wife given to the use of disagreeable words, a cowherd that desires always for the village (and not the pasture) and barber that desires for the wilderness.

sa: एकीभूतैर्महाप्राज्ञैः शूरैररिनिवर्हणैः। पाण्डवैः पृथिवीं तात भोक्ष्यसे सहितः सुखी॥
en: Having joined those ones endued with great wisdom, those heroes who are chastisers of their enemies, their enemies, those Pandavas, you will enjoy along with them this earth in happiness, my dear son.

sa: सात्यक्श्चिापि दुर्धर्षः सम्मतोऽन्धकवृष्णिषु। ध्वंसयिष्यत्ति ते सेनां पाण्डवेयहिते रतः॥
en: Satyaki, too, that one hard to be vanquished, who is respected among the Andhakas and the Vrishnis, will destroy your host; for he is ever attached to what is good for the Pandavas.

sa: आनृशंस्यमथो वृत्तं रक्षन् सत्पुरुषोचितम्। अतोऽर्थकरमप्येतन्न करोम्यद्य ते वचः॥
en: At the same time however showing due kindness and observing proper duties which ought to be observed by good men, I shall not act up to your words now as they are beneficial.

sa: तं शब्दं कुरवोऽजानन् विस्फोटमशनेरिवा यदर्जुनो धनुःश्रेष्ठं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद् रथे॥
en: From that sound great as it was like that of thunder, the Kurus came to know that Arjuna drew, with his hands, the string of the best of his bows from the car.

sa: त्वमितः पुण्डरीकाक्ष सुयोधनममर्षणम्। शान्त्यर्थं भ्रातरंब्रूया यत् तद् वाच्यममित्रहन्॥
en: Having set out from here, O you like lotus, being free from wrath to Suyodhana, with the objects of peace, speak to our brothers what should be spoken, O you slayer of enemies.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भिक्षाभुजो निवर्तन्तां ब्राह्मणा यतयश्च ये। क्षुत्तृडध्वश्रमायासशीतार्तिमसहिष्णवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : Let the mendicants, Brahmanas and Yogis who are incapable of bearing hunger and thirst, the fatigues of travel and toil and also the severity of winter desist (from following me).

sa: पुण्यं चाख्यायते दिव्यं शिवमग्निशिरोऽनघ। सहदेवोऽयजद् यत्र शम्याक्षेपेण भारत॥
en: O sinless one, O descendant of Bharata, here is also the celebrated celestials and auspicious Tirtha called Agnisshira, where Sahadeva performed a sacrifice by measuring out the ground by a throw of Shamya.

sa: योऽर्जुनेनार्जुनस्तुल्यो द्विवाहुबहुबाहुना। तमृते पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ वनं न प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: Draupadi said : Arjuna with two hands, is equal to Arjuna of many hands; in the absence of that foremost of the Pandavas, this forest does not at all look charming to me.
